Third pre-release of 2.1 — **syncing books** between the library on your computer and the e-reader.

## New

- **Books: computer ↔ e-reader** at the top of the E-reader area. Bookbench remembers the state of every book after each sync, so it knows on which side a book changed: new or changed books go across in both directions, books changed on both sides are shown with their differences (metadata, chapters, files in the EPUB) and left alone until you choose a side.
- Books deleted on one side: deleting them on the other side is offered, but never checked by default.
- Copies always go to the same path, so KOReader's reading position and highlights stay. Anything overwritten or deleted is backed up first.
- Link a library with an e-reader (*New library from e-reader* does it automatically). When that e-reader is connected, its library on the computer opens and is compared; the status bar and two new sidebar markers (books to sync, changed on both sides) tell you if there is something to do.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.1-beta3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
